title: Added grain paused. Edge noise takes priority.
summary: Episode 19 preserved original timing, but viewer feedback found excessive grain and distracting defects. Added grain is paused; a new compression test showed no clear improvement on real DVD pictures and was rejected.
problem: Small shifting speckles around outlines distract from the drawing. Smoothing them may also erase real detail.
response: The previous version remains the reference. The new test did not establish a visible improvement. A separate filter softened outlines without clearly removing noise.
beforeDetail: Archived comparison, 31 October: the previous version in the episode 8 Orihime close-up.
afterDetail: Archived comparison, 31 October: the new test at the identical moment and crop. Differences remain subtle.
imageNote: 2 November: no newly cleared pair. The featured comparison remains dated 31 October; all archives remain intact.
stageNote: Step 2 of the four-step review cycle: locate the defect before treating it.
nextStep: Complete the ongoing short-window analysis and compare viewer-confirmed outlines at matching moments. No treatment has been established.
